cards.ex: Come on, fess up! Who ate the last cookie?
cards.exUz: Kel, tan ol! Oxirgi pechenieni kim yedi?
cards.uzDef: Biror xato yoki jinoyatni tan olmoq, bo'yniga olmoq.

cards.ex: There's a grain of truth in what he says, even if I don't agree with him.
cards.exUz: Uning gapida ozgina haqiqat bor, men unga qo'shilmasam ham.
cards.uzDef: Ozgina haqiqat, biroz rost gap borligi.

cards.ex: The politician's career suffered a fall from grace after the scandal.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining karerasi janjaldan keyin obro'sizlanishga uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Obro'si yo'qotilishi, hurmatdan qolishi.

cards.ex: We negotiated the contract in good faith, believing both sides wanted a fair deal.
cards.exUz: Biz shartnomani sof niyatda muzokara qildik, ikki tomon ham adolatli kelishuvni xohlashiga ishonib.
cards.uzDef: Samimiy niyat bilan, halol yo'l bilan.

cards.ex: He cooked up a story about being stuck in traffic to explain why he was late.
cards.exUz: U kechikkanini tushuntirish uchun tirbandlikda qolib ketgani haqida uydirma to'qidi.
cards.uzDef: Yolg'on gaplar to'qimoq, uydirma hikoya yaratmoq.

cards.ex: Everyone knew the mayor was on the take, but nobody could prove it.
cards.exUz: Hamma merning poraxo'r ekanligini bilar edi, lekin hech kim buni isbotlay olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Poraxo'rlik bilan shug'ullanuvchi, pora oluvchi.

cards.ex: The treasurer needed to be above suspicion when handling the company's money.
cards.exUz: G'aznachining kompaniya pulini boshqarishda shubhadan xoli bo'lishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubha uyg'otmaydigan.

cards.ex: His strong moral compass guided him to always do the right thing.
cards.exUz: Uning kuchli axloqiy kompasiga ko'ra, u har doim to'g'ri ish qilishga intilar edi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy tamoyillar, to'g'ri va noto'g'rini ajrata olish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: His entire testimony was a pack of lies.
cards.exUz: Uning butun ko'rsatuvlari yolg'onlar to'plami edi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p yolg'on gaplar, uydirmalar.

cards.ex: The authorities often turn a blind eye to illegal parking in this area.
cards.exUz: Hokimiyatlar ko'pincha bu hududdagi noqonuniy to'xtashga ko'z yumadi.
cards.uzDef: Bilaturib e'tibor bermaslik, ko'rmaganga olish.

cards.ex: They tried to sweep the scandal under the rug, but the media found out anyway.
cards.exUz: Ular janjalni yashirishga harakat qilishdi, lekin ommaviy axborot vositalari baribir bilib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni yoki xatoni yashirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We need an honest broker to mediate the dispute between the two companies.
cards.exUz: Ikkala kompaniya o'rtasidagi nizoni hal qilish uchun bizga halol vositachi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va xolis vositachi.

cards.ex: He tends to bend the truth to make himself look better.
cards.exUz: U o'zini yaxshiroq ko'rsatish uchun haqiqatni biroz buzishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni biroz o'zgartirmoq, yolg'onga yaqin gapirmoq.

cards.ex: It's time for him to come clean about his involvement in the fraud.
cards.exUz: Uning firibgarlikdagi ishtiroki haqida haqiqatni aytish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni aytmoq, xato qilganini tan olmoq.

cards.ex: Some people argue that downloading music illegally is a victimless crime.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar noqonuniy ravishda musiqa yuklab olish jabrlanuvchisiz jinoyat deb ta'kidlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Hech kimga zarar yetkazmaydigan jinoyat.

cards.ex: I want to assure you that this business is completely on the up and up.
cards.exUz: Sizni ishontirmoqchimanki, bu biznes butunlay halol yo'l bilan yuritiladi.
cards.uzDef: Halol va to'g'ri yo'l bilan qilingan.

cards.ex: He was arrested for allegedly falsifying documents to get a loan.
cards.exUz: U kredit olish uchun hujjatlarni soxtalashtirganlikda gumonlanib hibsga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Hujjatlarni yolg'on ma'lumotlar bilan to'ldirish yoki o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: The company pays lip service to environmental protection but continues to pollute.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilishni faqat so'zda qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, lekin ifloslantirishda davom etadi.
cards.uzDef: Amalda hech narsa qilmasdan faqat so'z bilan qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: His actions were a serious breach of trust.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari ishonchni jiddiy suiiste'mol qilish edi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchni buzish, xiyonat qilish.

cards.ex: They tried to cover up the accident, but the truth eventually came out.
cards.exUz: Ular baxtsiz hodisani yashirishga harakat qilishdi, lekin haqiqat oxir-oqibat yuzaga chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni, xatoni yoki jinoyatni yashirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The company was accused of cooking the books to inflate its profits.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya foydasini oshirish uchun buxgalteriya hisobotlarini soxtalashtirishda ayblandi.
cards.uzDef: Buxgalteriya hisobotlarini soxtalashtirish, aldash.

cards.ex: It's a no-brainer: honesty is always the best policy.
cards.exUz: Bu oddiy narsa: halollik har doim eng yaxshi siyosatdir.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday fikrlashni talab qilmaydigan oson qaror.

cards.ex: He committed the crime, but somehow managed to get off scot-free.
cards.exUz: U jinoyat qildi, lekin qandaydir tarzda jazosiz qutulishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday jazo olmasdan qutulmoq.

cards.ex: He was caught fudging the numbers on his expense report.
cards.exUz: U xarajatlar hisobotida raqamlarni soxtalashtirganlikda qo'lga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Raqamlarni o'zgartirish orqali aldash.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha bizneslar uchun teng sharoit yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va teng sharoit.

cards.ex: Those responsible for the corruption should be held accountable.
cards.exUz: Korruptsiyaga mas'ul bo'lganlar javobgar bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan ishi uchun javobgarlikka tortilmoq.

cards.ex: He pulled some strings to get his son a job.
cards.exUz: U o'g'liga ish topish uchun sirtdan ta'sir o'tkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Sirtdan ta'sir o'tkazish, foyda uchun o'z aloqalaridan foydalanish.

cards.ex: If you want to succeed, you have to play by the rules.
cards.exUz: Agar muvaffaqiyatga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qoidalarga rioya qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga muvofiq harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: She managed to turn the tables on her accusers.
cards.exUz: U ayblovchilarga qarshi vaziyatni o'zgartirishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni teskarisiga o'zgartirmoq, ustunlikni qaytarib olmoq.

cards.ex: The robbery happened in broad daylight.
cards.exUz: O'g'irlik kunduz kuni sodir bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiqchasiga, hech kimdan yashirmasdan.
